content.title: About
content.content: Gold potatoes without skin are a variety of tubers with a yellowish flesh that are often served raw after the skin is removed. They have a delicate, slightly sweet flavor and a crisp texture. Raw potatoes are commonly used in salads, appetizers, and for making juices.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Gold potatoes are richer in carotenoids than regular potatoes, giving them their yellow color.
The “Gold” variety was developed in the United States in the 1970s and quickly gained popularity for its tender texture.
Raw skin‑less potatoes are frequently used in baby foods because they are easier to digest.
Potatoes without skin contain less phytic acid than those with skin, improving mineral absorption.
Raw gold potatoes can be blended into green smoothies, adding a bright hue.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Raw potatoes provide vitamin C, which supports the immune system and collagen synthesis.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potassium helps regulate fluid balance and supports heart function.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and contributes to satiety.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Raw potatoes contain virtually no fat, making them suitable for low‑calorie diets.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Carotenoids and phenolic compounds in gold potatoes have antioxidant properties.

items.title: Solanine content
items.content: Raw potatoes may contain solanine, a toxin that appears in green parts of the tuber. Green spots should be removed before consumption.

items.title: Digestive discomfort
items.content: Some individuals may experience gas or stomach upset after eating raw potatoes.

items.title: Allergic reactions
items.content: Rarely, people can be allergic to potatoes, showing skin rashes or swelling.

items.title: Portion control
items.content: Large amounts of raw potato can lead to excess starch, which may affect blood sugar levels.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Thinly slice raw gold potatoes without skin and add them to salads, marinate in lemon juice, or blend into vegetable smoothies. Always wash and peel the tubers thoroughly before use.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store peeled raw potatoes in an airtight container in the refrigerator to prevent oxidation. Use within 2–3 days. Discard if the potatoes darken or develop an off‑odor.
